name: Reverse Scry
body:
School abjuration; Level cleric/oracle 9, sorcerer/wizard 8

CASTING

Casting Time 1 round; see text
Components V, S, DF

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 hr./caster level
Saving Throw none (harmless); see text; Spell Resistance no; see text

DESCRIPTION

Dragonkin are the race most closely associated with mastery of this spell, although other appropriate races may choose it at the GM’s discretion.

Whenever you are the target of a spell with the scrying descriptor or an ability with a scrying effect, you are immediately aware of the attempt. As a swift action, you may target the opposing caster with a greater scrying spell.

If you do, reverse scry grants a +5 bonus to overcome the target’s spell resistance and imposes a -5 penalty on the target’s Will save.
